## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-TASK-671-01` — The tools match the design: get_storage_summary on the ring, explain_growth, get_health, list_review_items, list_largest_objects, get_review_item_evidence, and measure_path (one path inside configured scopes, 15 s and 500k entries, joining a running review); find_cleanup_candidates, list_current_consumers and get_evidence_lifecycle are replaced, the list_active_writers alias is dropped, get_provenance is listed only while the Endpoint Security bridge is active, and export_evidence exports the new store plus the legacy store read-only.
- `AC-TASK-671-02` — Every tool answers under the 1 MiB ceiling with every table at its cap and with the detail store unavailable; asked what can be cleaned in localGit, an agent quotes the same numbers and states as the review window.

## Required Evidence

- `EVREQ-TASK-671-01` (regression-evidence) — Tool contract tests at caps and under detail faults through the real helper transport.
- `EVREQ-TASK-671-02` (integration-evidence) — Agent scenario transcript compared with the window's report.
